purpose: Replicate the existing Ridge training/evaluation method on a separately sourced retail dataset and disjoint calendar period. This is retraining the method, not transfer of the FreshRetailNet boosting weights.

source.citation: Chen, D. (2015). Online Retail [Dataset]. UCI Machine Learning Repository. https://doi.org/10.24432/C5BW33
source.checksumPolicy: Compute SHA256 and content SHA1 from the original XLSX at initial download and freeze a source lock before parsing records. These are locally computed content pins, not publisher-provided checksums. Future runs require the same lock.

calendar.boundaryPolicy: Exclude both publisher coverage boundary dates, 2010-12-01 and 2011-12-09, because completeness of each boundary day is not assured. Use source local calendar dates as published; do not relabel as Asia/Jakarta.

target: Daily sum of positive Quantity for positive-priced, non-cancelled published invoice lines with stock codes matching ^[0-9]{5}[A-Za-z]?$, grouped by Country. Gross invoiced product units, not net demand, revenue, ingredient use or latent sales.
aggregation: SUM of the selected published event log by country/date. Calendar groups with no matching event have sum 0 by the target definition; these are empty-event aggregates, not imputed unknown demand or generated transactions. Preserve duplicate published invoice rows; do not infer refunds against earlier orders. CustomerID and Description are not used or copied to processed data.

selection.policy: Select every country with at least 100 distinct positive-sales dates AND at least 1000 gross units in the development interval, and a positive mean in its first 84 development dates. Selection uses development records only. No sample replacement, test-dependent inclusion or relaxing thresholds.

normalization: For each country divide daily gross units by the mean of its first 84 development calendar dates. This fixed positive scale uses only early fitting history; no validation or external targets. Preserve native float ratios. normalized_sales is a derived dimensionless target; also report errors after inverse scaling.
fitting: Reuse server/ml/forecast-model.mjs unchanged: target next two days, 14-day features, ten Ridge candidates (lags/calendar x alpha .01,.1,1,10,100), chronological last 7 origins internal test, preceding 7 validation, earlier origins fitting. Choose by validation MAE only, refit train+validation, no fit on internal/external test. Save all selected countries including losers.
externalTest: Nineteen non-overlapping two-day targets over 2011-11-01 through 2011-12-08, fixed learned weights. Actual earlier test days may enter later lags. No model refit, parameter selection or threshold changes after reading external scores.
primaryMetric: Pooled external WAPE in normalized-sales units, comparing all methods on exactly the same selected country/date targets.
reporting: Report all selected countries and every target, internal scores, external pooled normalized MAE/WAPE, inverse-scaled gross-unit MAE/WAPE, equal-country mean WAPE with undefined-country counts, by-origin errors, zero-event aggregate counts and all exclusions. Raw-unit pooled metrics may be dominated by the UK; disclose its target share. Pipeline failures fail the run, never silently drop a country.
restrictions: Public benchmark only, isolated from user accounts. Country aggregates from one retailer are correlated, not independent shops. Gift/wholesale sales in 2010-2011 are a different task from fresh-product store sales in 2024; no direct numeric v1/v2 comparison, no claim that boosting generalized, no Indonesian pilot, no public-model activation or Qwen fine-tuning. After the first report this external test is known and repetition is reproducibility only.
